paper_title: MARBLE A Hard Benchmark for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning and Planning
caption: : Search space of the dataset under different configurations.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the number of possible solutions against the number of missing pieces for the M-Cube dataset under different configurations. The x-axis represents "# Missing pieces", is linearly scaled, ranges from 1 to 6, and has tick labels at every integer value. The y-axis represents "# Possible solutions", is logarithmically scaled, and ranges from 10^2 to 10^8. Two lines are shown in the plot: the orange line with circle markers and a solid style represents "Flip needed", starting at approximately 10^2 at x=1 and increasing to around 10^8 at x=6; the blue line with circle markers and a solid style represents "Flip ignored", starting at around 10^1 at x=1 and rising to about 10^6 at x=6. Both lines exhibit an upward trend as the number of missing pieces increases, with the orange line consistently higher than the blue line across the entire range.
